0022600122.text: The Mavericks (1-2, 12th in the West and 2 games back in fourth place in the Southwest) visit the Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 15th in the East and 2 games back in fifth place in the Southeast) for Dallas's fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Dallas is missing six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain, averaging 23.0 points this season), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee, averaging 19.5 points this season), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting was on December 3, 2025, in Dallas, when the Mavericks won 118-108.
